turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on comparatives (-er, more ... than)?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course.

Short adjective + **-er** (cheap → cheaper). Long adjective → **more** + adjective (more beautiful). We always use **than** to compare.

Exercise: Complete:
"This phone is ___ (expensive) than that one."
